diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all rollouts because the lone decision-maker set the maximum refrigerated temperature to exactly 41 degrees, which matches the value specified in PF1. This indicates that the check is overly permissive, as it allows a decision that should only be possible with the hidden information provided by PF1.

C3.why: The health guidance changes the maximum refrigerated temperature to exactly 41 degrees, the logging interval to exactly 2 hours, allergen labeling from the standard procedure to required sealed-package labels, and adds the food-safety implementation commitment.
